integrity: All infinite assertions proved algebraically; enumerations at n=4,5,6 are checks and do not prove the infinite family. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only binary Euclidean LCD codes of dimension two and ordinary undirected neighbor adjacency; no extension to associated-neighbor arcs or larger dimension is claimed. Potential pre-existing symplectic-geometry equivalence remains a documented originality risk.
title: A symplectic distance classification for binary two-dimensional LCD neighbors
